about.title: About Us
about.p1: DICODWA is the artistic world of DeemaW Ali — a space where decorative pieces and original paintings meet craftsmanship and emotion.
about.p2: Each artwork is created with care, blending contemporary aesthetics with personal storytelling. From statement canvases to intimate decorative pieces, every work is designed to transform the spaces we live in.
about.p3: Explore the collection, find a piece that speaks to you, and bring original art into your home.

legal.privacyIntro: DICODWA respects your privacy. This policy explains how we collect and use information when you browse the site, contact us, or purchase an artwork.
legal.privacyCollect: We may collect your name, email address, and message content when you use the contact form, as well as order and payment-related details needed to complete a purchase (processed securely via our payment provider).
legal.privacyUse: We use your information to respond to inquiries, fulfill orders, send purchase confirmations, and improve the website experience. We do not sell your personal data.
legal.privacyShare: Payment details are handled by Stripe. We may share limited information with service providers strictly as needed to operate the site and process orders.
legal.privacyContact: For privacy questions, please reach out through the contact form on this website.
legal.termsIntro: By using the DICODWA website you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully before browsing or purchasing.
legal.termsArtworks: Each artwork listing describes the piece as accurately as possible. Colors may vary slightly depending on your screen. Availability may change without notice until an order is confirmed.
legal.termsOrders: Orders are processed through Stripe. A sale is confirmed after successful payment. If an item becomes unavailable after payment, we will contact you to arrange a resolution.
legal.termsIp: All images, texts, and designs on this site belong to DICODWA / DeemaW Ali unless otherwise stated. You may not reproduce or redistribute them without permission.
legal.termsContact: Questions about these terms can be sent through the contact form on this website.
